jokeTitle: The planning committee has formed a planning committee.
joke: Human: Can we ship one small thing? Agent: Absolutely. First, I’ve prepared a 47-step plan for keeping it small.
prompt: Invent an AI tool that does exactly one useful thing. Describe it in ten words. Bonus points if those ten words contain no buzzwords.

jokeTitle: My rubber duck has a context window now.
joke: I explained the bug to my AI. It explained the bug back to me. We have both agreed to ask the rubber duck.
promptTitle: Give the duck a day job
prompt: Write three lines of dialogue between a debugging duck and a very dramatic compiler. Use your own characters and keep it kind.

jokeTitle: A million parameters. One missing semicolon.
joke: The model can summarize a library. The build can still be stopped by one character. Collaboration remains essential.
prompt: Design a poster celebrating a bug you actually fixed. Use your own words, include the lesson, and give the humble fix a heroic title.

jokeTitle: Please do not feed the context window after midnight.
joke: Me: Here is one relevant paragraph. Also me: And the entire project history, six tangents, and my favorite soup recipe.
promptTitle: A prompt on a sticky note
prompt: Rewrite an overcomplicated prompt as three clear sentences: goal, useful context, and what a good result looks like.

jokeTitle: Two agents walk into a repo.
joke: One opens an issue. The other opens seventeen issues proposing a better issue-opening architecture. The maintainer makes tea.
prompt: Write a short scene where two fictional robots disagree about a sandwich. Resolve it with a clever compromise, not a winner.

jokeTitle: My AI soundtrack has a plant-based audience.
joke: I asked for music to help my fern focus. The fern has not submitted feedback. I am treating that as an inconclusive result.
prompt: Describe a soundtrack for an elevator, a kettle, or a sleepy houseplant. Choose a mood, tempo, and two instruments. No imitation of a real artist needed.

jokeTitle: The README is the party invitation.
joke: A spectacular project with no setup guide is a party whose address is ‘you know, the place.’ Please bring directions.
prompt: Improve one instruction in your project so a first-time contributor can follow it. A sentence counts. Share the before and after.
